notes.hook: Combining Cold War nuclear espionage with the brightest blasts in the cosmos is an instant swipe-stopper.
notes.clarity: The narrative flows cleanly from satellite launch to unexpected sensor blip to cosmological discovery.
notes.payoff: The revelation that military surveillance satellites accidentally discovered cosmic gamma-ray bursts is deeply satisfying.
notes.visuals: Crisp mix of authentic Vela satellite archival photos and striking astrophysical event renders.
notes.loop: The echoed phrasing bridges the end back to the start smoothly, though the sentence boundary is slightly noticeable.

rounds.better_than_last: It pairs genuine Cold War military surveillance history with extreme deep-space astrophysics for a richer, more surprising payoff than ep040.
